sources.title: Zimbabwe Department of Immigration: Category B
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Department of Immigration page identifies the Department as a Zimbabwe government immigration authority and directly links the official eVisa service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Category B nationals may obtain a visa at the port of entry after paying the corresponding fee.

sources.title: Zimbabwe eVisa FAQ and nationality visa regime
sources.officialityEvidence: The live portal identifies the Department of Immigration and provides its departmental contact details.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Bolivia is listed among visitors required to obtain a visa before travelling to Zimbabwe.

unresolved.reason: Not established: current official Category B names Bolivia as eligible for a paid port-of-entry visa, while the live official eVisa FAQ places Bolivia in its pre-travel-visa list. No dated amendment or hierarchy reconciles the conflict.
